description:
**Surfaced 2026-05-16 by ADA during Arc 26 Phase 2 build (stoa--dxw).** ADA had to run `git add -f` to stage agents/design/arc-26/design.md + design-rev2.md because the repo's .gitignore line `design/` matches them. The current rule is over-broad: it blocks intentional arc-design artifacts that ARE meant to be committed (per the substrate's documented practice of committing arc designs alongside arc directives).

## The fix

Narrow .gitignore so it does not block agents/design/arc-*/ paths. Likely either:

1. Replace bare `design/` with a more specific pattern (e.g., `/design/` for root-only, if the intent was to ignore a top-level `design/` scratch dir).
2. Add an explicit unignore: `!agents/design/arc-*/`.

Inspect first to understand what the bare `design/` rule was originally for; the fix should preserve the original intent while unblocking arc design directories.

## Why P4

Annoying but not blocking — future arcs will hit it; either we forget and re-force-add each time, or we fix once. Fix-now discipline (substrate §4.8) says fix-once is cheaper.

## Cross-ref

- stoa--dxw — Arc 26 ticket (where ADA surfaced this)
- commit 9953f95 on arc-26/build — the build commit that needed git add -f
title: Arc 26 follow-up: .gitignore 'design/' rule too broad (forced git add -f during build)
